description: Access the portal through personal credential authentication.
The user accesses the login screen of the portal, enters username and password, the system validates the credentials, and if valid, grants access to the portal.
Visualize the applications of the portal to which the user has access.
Upon user login, the system queries the list of applications the user has access to and displays the corresponding list.
Access the applications to which the user has access within the portal.

When the user selects an application from the list, if they only have access to one application, they are redirected to its main page; if they have access to more than one, they select the application they want to access and are redirected to its main page.
Restrict the visualization and actions (create, modify, and delete) on data according to the roles assigned to the user.
When the user accesses the Commercial Cloud data management application, the system verifies the user's roles and permissions, permitting or denying actions and screen access accordingly.
Ensure that data from other clients cannot be accessed.
As the user navigates through screens of both the portal and applications, the system verifies the client associated with the user and only displays data from the same client.
Convert any mention of the old name to the new name.
When the user accesses the portal or the Commercial Cloud data management application and navigates through screens, the new name is shown wherever a mention is made.
Grant or remove access to applications for users.

An authenticated administrator with administrator roles accesses the Commercial Cloud application, navigates to the user application management screen, selects a user, adds or removes access from the available applications list, and the system updates the affected user's data so that their application list is modified upon logging into the portal.
The new content must maintain visual coherence with the design of the old version of the application.
The design, colors, typographies, and organization must be consistent with the old version.
The system must be easy to use for any user.
80% of users do not need to ask for help from a third party to use the application.
The application must be available in multiple languages.
Complete and correct translations in both languages.
The user must be able to perform the new operations without special training.
The learning time for the new functionalities should not exceed 5 minutes.
Query operations must have a loading time of less than 1 second.
Response time must not exceed 1 second in 95% of queries.
The web application must guarantee continuous and stable operation, ensuring its availability at any time.
The system availability must be a minimum of 99.9%, even during intensive use moments.
The web application must support a large number of simultaneous users without degrading its performance.
The system availability must be a minimum of 99.9%, even during intensive use moments.
The system must allow the creation, consultation, modification, and deletion of data to authorized users.
The system must feature a secure authentication and permission verification mechanism to ensure that each user can only access the information and functionalities corresponding to them.
The application must manage a strict data separation for each client.
No user can access data from other clients.
